profile.name: Stephen Cheng
profile.title: Senior Dynamics 365 Business Central & AL Developer

professionalSummary: Senior Developer with over 10 years of software engineering experience, highly specialized in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central and AL programming. Proven track record in designing, developing, and deploying complex ERP extensions, custom modules, and cross-platform system integrations. Strong expertise in optimizing Business Central architectures, building OData/REST API integrations, and leveraging the broader Microsoft Power Platform ecosystem (Power BI, Power Automate) and Azure Cloud. Adept at migrating legacy NAV systems to modern D365 BC cloud environments and leading technical implementations that drive operational efficiency and measurable business value.
